- [RARC.13.17] **A read's visitor callback refuses re-entry too.** An
  enumerating read — of working memory, of the network's nodes and edges, of a
  match trace, of refracted activations — invokes a callback once per item it
  visits. [RARC.13.16]'s refusal holds inside that callback, for every call on
  the engine being enumerated. The enumeration is not on the pump's stack, but
  it is in progress: a call from inside it that mutates what is being
  enumerated invalidates the enumeration, and a read observes it half-visited.
  A call on a different engine is unaffected.
